name: Nemesgulács (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nemesgulács (a red and green shield with a bunch of grapes, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and red, blue and grey mantling) between the year 2000 above and the name NEMESGULÁCS below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nemesgulács arms with helm, crest and mantling
